title: Precision Anchoring Harness for Embed-Rerank Evaluation
creator: Diego Martinez
description: Build a reproducible, low-noise evaluation harness to measure absolute and relative accuracy of embeddings used in reranking endpoints. The harness (Precision Anchoring Harness) will combine curated golden pairs, cohort stratification, and a deterministic offline reranker to isolate model/regression signals from infrastructure noise. Goals: 1) surface small but meaningful degradation in rerank ordering (precision@k / nDCG) across model/quantization/sequence-length changes; 2) enable nightly/regression pipelines and canaries; 3) provide cohort-level drift alerts and explainable failure modes for SRE/ML engineers.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Harness runs end-to-end on CI with a canonical golden set and produces reproducible precision@1, precision@3, nDCG@5 metrics within historical variance bounds; 2) A nightly batch job ingests recent production cohorts and emits drift scores per cohort to metrics; 3) Alerts created when cohort drift or CI regression exceeds thresholds; 4) Documentation and runbook describing how to add new golden pairs, interpret logs, and create follow-up tickets; 5) One initial canary run for a quantized model variant documented and linked to a PR.
technical_notes: Architecture: harness will live in eval/anchors service and include: (a) goldenset store (versioned JSONL with SHA256 manifests), (b) deterministic offline reranker that uses saved model logits/embeddings and a fixed ranking head, (c) cohort stratifier that splits by sequence length, template type, and traffic source, (d) metric calculator supporting precision@k, mrr, nDCG and a pairwise ranking loss proxy. Determinism: seed sources enumerated and KV-cache effects neutralized by replay fixture. Storage: golden sets & manifests stored in S3 with lifecycle policy; results written to metrics pipeline (Prometheus pushgateway -> Cortex) and long-term artifacts in GCS. Trade-offs: deterministic rerank reduces fidelity versus live inference (no batching, no dynamic routing), but is required to detect small regressions. Next steps to approximate production will include a stochastic-sampled live-runner.
milestones: 1) M1 (2025-03-10): Spec and goldenset curator script. 2) M2 (2025-03-17): Deterministic offline reranker + metric calc. 3) M3 (2025-03-24): CI integration & nightly job. 4) M4 (2025-03-31): Cohort stratification and drift alerting. 5) M5 (2025-04-07): Docs, runbook, and production canary example.
test_plan: Unit tests for metric calc and rerank determinism. Integration test that runs harness on a small golden set and asserts stable metric outputs across two runs. Regression test that compares new model outputs against baseline and fails CI when delta > configured threshold. Backfill smoke run against last 30 days of sampled production traffic to validate cohort sampling code. Load test to ensure nightly runner can process 100k pairs within a 2-hour window.
telemetry: Emit per-run summary metrics: embed_eval.precision_at_1, embed_eval.precision_at_3, embed_eval.ndcg_at_5, embed_eval.pairwise_loss. Emit cohort tags: sequence_length_bin, template_category, source_region. Log artifact URIs and manifest SHAs on run completion. Send anomaly events to ops-alerting when rolling 7-day z-score > 3 for any cohort. Store raw per-query ranked lists for 30 days for debugging.
rollout_plan: Alpha: run in dev CI using synthetic golden set. Beta: run nightly on sampled production cohorts for internal dashboards and SRE review. Canary: expose a canary pipeline that compares quantized model variant against baseline on a small, high-signal golden set and gate larger rollout on no significant regressions for 3 consecutive nightly runs. Production: schedule daily runs and attach automated alerts to the PagerDuty routing for ML SRE when critical cohorts degrade.
risks: False positives from unstable golden sets; mitigate by strict manifesting and checksum validation. Overfitting to goldenset artifiacts; mitigate by rotating held-out pairs and adding synthetic perturbations. Metric mismatch vs user-facing metrics due to reranker determinism; address with periodic live comparisons. Cost: nightly run compute cost; mitigate by sampling and incremental updates.
